records.Name: Pratik Shinde
records.Tagline__c: I build integrations, automation and agents that replace manual work with systems that heal themselves.
records.Bio__c:
Pratik is a Salesforce Developer who designs, builds and supports enterprise-scale Salesforce solutions for one of Europe's largest online food-delivery marketplaces. Since February 2024 he has delivered 538+ work items across engineering, production support and infrastructure for sales and operations teams in 7+ European markets.

His strongest area is Apex: REST web services, asynchronous processing (Queueable, Batch, Schedulable), trigger frameworks and Lightning Web Components. He designs integrations with Named Credentials, OAuth 2.0, Platform Events and metadata-driven field mapping, and owns delivery end to end: solution design, build, CI/CD, go-live and hypercare.

He reaches for declarative tools first, and for robust, governor-limit-safe Apex and LWC when the problem demands it.
records.Open_To_Roles__c: Salesforce Developer · Salesforce Engineer · Technical Consultant
